text:
There must exist a city of moss

whose sky of grays, at sunset,

is crossed by green angels with wings

fallen from frayed glass.

And cold mirrors in the grass

on whose edges, bent over, weep

long widows of yellowish wind

that the glass blurs as they sway.


And a point in the space of hanging

water weeds; and a dead girl

who goes thinking on clover feet.

And a grotto that sweetly rains

vegetable batrachians that shatter,

newborn leaves, on the soft silt.

translation.title: Suggestion of a Willow
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the surreal botanic atmosphere and the unusual batrachian image.
